title: Dem wins N.H. House seat by one vote after recount
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Politics Overall, four incoming New Hampshire state lawmakers won their seats by a single vote.
Lane Turner / The Boston Globe, File A New Hampshire House of Representatives seat was decided after a recount revealed the Democrat won by a single vote.
Vivian Marie Hall defeated Republican Michael Visconti by just one vote to earn the seat representing Franklin, according to the New Hampshire Secretary of State’s Office.
